headline: KEC International Q2 Profit Slides as Margin Pressure Offsets Record Orders
summary: KEC International reported that record order inflows were offset by margin pressure, causing second-quarter fiscal 2027 earnings to slide.
why: KEC International is a prominent engineering and infrastructure contractor whose margins reflect raw material cost inflation and project execution efficiency.

impacts.name: KEC International Limited
impacts.why: Margin compression directly reduces net profitability despite healthy order backlogs.
